title: IP Talking Video
subtitle: Turn your ideas into a talking video, ready to share.
demoBoundary: Local demo: no paid model calls or account charges. Demo video has no voice track.
realBoundary: Live speech runs through platform background jobs; covers and video are composed locally.
galleryTitle: Start with a template that fits your story
galleryDescription: Prepare your script, voice and cover. All templates are built in and assets can be replaced.

scroll.name: Scrolling captions
scroll.description: Three-line scrolling captions keep each idea in focus.

poster.name: Bold headline
poster.description: Give your viewpoint space with bold poster typography.

call.name: Incoming call
call.description: Open a personal conversation with an incoming-call cover.

career.name: Career insights
career.description: Editorial typography for professional insights and reflections.

life.name: Life journal
life.description: Quiet spacing and paper-inspired typography for everyday stories.

lesson.name: Knowledge board
lesson.description: Clear titles and contrasting captions for lessons and methods.

audiogram.name: Audio waveform
audiogram.description: Podcast-style waveform driven by voice amplitude for thoughtful spoken stories.

tiktok.name: TikTok pop captions
tiktok.description: Word-level color emphasis with consistent wrapping and spacing for fast-paced spoken videos.

demoCase: Layout demo · not real traffic data
scriptStepDescription: Paste your script or collect reference text through the connected extension.
audioStepDescription: Choose a voice and speed, then confirm which take to use.
coverStepDescription: Choose a cover or create one with your photo and a built-in layout.
linkPlaceholder: Paste a public {{platform}} or other supported work URL
demoLinkNote: Demo mode returns this template’s sample script rather than fetching the URL.
realLinkNote: Collects existing text through the extension. A video without text will not receive a fabricated transcription.
urlRequired: Enter a reference video URL first.
urlInvalid: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.
scriptHint: At least 20 characters. Keep it under 5 minutes. Punctuation defines caption segments.
scriptPlaceholder: Start with an idea you want to explain. Paste your script here…
editInvalidates: Editing requires a new voice track
useAudio: Use this take and choose a cover
silentDemoAudio: The demo track only represents timing and caption layout; it contains no generated speech. Live mode can generate actual speech.
customVoiceFailed: Personal voices could not be loaded. Registered platform voices are still available.
sampleUnavailable: No verified platform sample endpoint is available. Generate a voice track to listen, or manage voices on the voice page.
sampleUnsupported: This browser does not support local speech preview.
sampleText: Hello, I would like to share a small discovery with you today.
browserVoiceDemo: Playing the browser’s system voice, not a real sample of the selected platform voice.
audioLoadFailed: Could not load audio. Retry through background tasks.
queued: Voice task queued. Check background tasks or this page’s history.
tooLong: Estimated duration exceeds 5 minutes. Shorten the script or increase speed.
audioRequired: Live video requires an actual voice track. Generate and confirm audio first.
coverComposeBoundary: Your photo stays in this browser for local layout. Built-in covers are also available.
coverTextHint: Up to 32 characters. Keep it short so the subject stays visible.
coverCreated: Cover created and saved in this browser.
aiCoverPending: AI portrait generation is pending integration. Current output is an actual local photo-and-type layout, not AI-generated imagery.
pointsInsufficient: Insufficient demo credits. Use an existing cover or video. Account credits are unaffected.
renderNote: An actual video file is created in this browser. Keep this page in the foreground; rendering takes roughly the video’s duration.
renderUnsupported: Local video encoding is unavailable. Use a recent Chrome or Edge browser.
resultDemoNote: This is a silent demo video. Edit the captions and download the actual file.
resultRealNote: Actual speech and cover have been composed. Adjust caption styles and export again.
subtitleStyleDescription: Drag the dashed frame in the preview, or use the position slider.
styleDirty: Layout or captions have changed. Recompose before downloading to match the preview.
downloadStarted: Download submitted. Check your browser’s download list.
coverPlaceholder: Choose a cover to preview here
historyLocal: Saved only in this account’s current browser. Up to 12 videos / 250 MB, without cross-device sync.
historySaveFailed: Video created, but local history could not be saved: {{error}}. Download the video now.
historyEmpty: No videos yet. Choose a template to start.

encoding.editNote: Adjust text, photos and captions before exporting locally. This draft has not been encoded or saved to video history.
encoding.pendingExport: 1080 × 1920 · Not exported; available formats depend on your browser
encoding.workerNote: Composing frames in a dedicated worker. Keep this page open; browser suspension or closing the page can interrupt the task.
encoding.offlineNote: Creating frames locally without playing the entire voice track. Speed depends on the assets and device; download when complete.

errors.invalidDuration: Video duration must be greater than zero and no longer than 5 minutes.
errors.invalidLayout: Invalid layout. Check layer positions, dimensions and text styles.
errors.invalidSubtitle: Invalid caption timing. Check order, overlaps and total duration.
errors.subtitleOverflow: Text exceeds its frame. Enlarge the frame or reduce the font size before exporting; text will not be truncated.
errors.audioDurationMismatch: Audio duration differs from the project. Confirm the voice track again.
errors.invalidAudio: Audio could not be processed or exceeds local limits. Use mono or stereo audio no longer than 5 minutes.
errors.audioDecodeUnsupported: Audio decoding is unavailable. Use a recent Chrome or Edge browser.
errors.invalidImage: Image is invalid or exceeds 40 megapixels. Resize it and retry.
errors.exportTooLarge: Assets or video exceed the 250 MB local limit. Shorten the content or compress assets.
errors.capacityLimit: Video exceeds 250 MB. Shorten the content and export again.
errors.encodeFailed: Local encoding failed. Check browser support and export again.
errors.encodingFailed: Browser recording failed. Keep this page in the foreground and retry.
errors.foregroundRequired: Compatibility recording requires this page to stay in the foreground. Return to the page and export again.
errors.mediaTimeout: Local export timed out. Please retry.
errors.canvasFailed: Could not create a canvas. Close resource-intensive tabs and retry.
errors.audioBlocked: Audio processing was blocked. Click Export again.
errors.renderUnsupported: No supported video encoder is available. Use a recent Chrome or Edge browser.

editor.label: Fixed-template editor
editor.canvasHelp: Drag or resize the selected frame. Arrow keys move by 1 output pixel; Shift + arrow keys move by 10. Title and captions are rendered only on the canvas.
editor.overflow: Text exceeds its frame; no content has been removed. Enlarge the frame, reduce the font size or edit the text to keep it within the exported picture.
editor.coordinateHelp: Coordinates and dimensions use 1080 × 1920 output pixels. Reset restores layout and styles while keeping your title, script and captions.

timing.estimated: Estimated timing · derived from script sentences, not speech recognition
timing.srt: SRT timing · using the imported file’s timecodes
timing.manual: Manual timing · caption text or timecodes have been edited

editor.timingHelp: Times are in seconds. Total duration: {{duration}} seconds. Segments must be ordered, must not overlap and must end within the audio duration. Text edits do not regenerate speech.
editor.unsavedCaptions: Caption edits have not been applied. Apply them before importing or exporting. All draft text is retained if validation fails.
editor.noCaptions: No captions yet. Import an SRT file to start.
editor.captionsApplied: Caption edits applied. You can undo them.
editor.srtImported: SRT imported. Undo will restore the previous captions.
editor.srtExported: SRT download submitted. Check your browser’s download list.
editor.presetsHelp: Saves layout and styles only, without scripts, captions, title text or images. Presets are isolated by account and kept only in this browser, up to {{max}} presets. Selecting a preset applies it immediately and can be undone.
editor.presetSaved: Layout preset saved in this browser.
editor.presetDeleted: Preset deleted. Your current project is unchanged.
editor.presetApplied: Layout preset applied. Project text and captions are unchanged.

errors.invalidSubtitle: Invalid caption format or timing. Text must not be empty, start must precede end, segments must not overlap and all times must fit within the audio. Existing captions and unapplied draft text have been retained.
errors.assetLimit: The SRT file exceeds 1 MB. Choose a smaller file. Existing captions are unchanged.
errors.invalidLayout: Invalid layout parameters. Check coordinates, dimensions and text styles.
errors.invalidOwner: Sign in with a valid account to use local layout presets.
errors.storageUnavailable: Local preset storage is unavailable. Check browser permissions or free storage and retry. Your current edits remain on this page.
errors.invalidPresetName: Enter a preset name of 1–80 characters.
errors.presetLimit: The 20-preset limit has been reached. Delete an unused preset first.
errors.operationFailed: The operation could not be completed. Please retry. Existing project content has not been replaced.
